body: Don Toliver just kicked off his “NITROUS” era with the video for his new single “Party With The Boys” Set in Oslo, Norway, the visual features an appearance from Bam Margera—bringing an unexpected link-up to the start of Don’s next chapter 🇳🇴 With his upcoming album “NITROUS” on the way, this is our first taste of the new era. Don and Bam in Oslo is already a wild way to get things started How’s “Party With The Boys” sounding?

Don Toliver just kicked off his “NITROUS” era with the video for his new single “Party With The Boys” 🤯🔥

Set in Oslo, Norway, the visual features an appearance from Bam Margera—bringing an unexpected link-up to the start of Don’s next chapter 🇳🇴👀

With his upcoming album “NITROUS” on the way, this is our first taste of the new era. Don and Bam in Oslo is already a wild way to get things started 😭🏁
